description: Defines structures and constants related to Master Boot Record (MBR) and partition entries, including size calculations and packed attribute for memory layout.

classes.name: MbrPartitionEntry
classes.description: Represents a partition entry in the MBR, including status, CHS addresses, partition type, first LBA, and sector count.

classes.name: MasterBootRecord
classes.description: Represents the Master Boot Record structure, including bootstrap code, partition entries, and boot signature.

methods.name: static_assert
methods.description: Ensures at compile time that the size of MasterBootRecord matches the sector size.
